_meta.source: BIR / Tax Code, as amended by RA 9337 (2005) and RA 10963 (TRAIN, 2018). Digital services brought under VAT by RA 12023 (2024), effective 2025-06-02.
notes: 12% rate has been stable since RA 9337 (effective 2005-11-01).
Threshold of ₱3,000,000 in gross annual sales set by TRAIN (RA 10963) effective 2018-01-01; previously ₱1,919,500.
Below threshold = subject to percentage tax (3%) instead of VAT, unless voluntarily VAT-registered.
Digital service providers became VAT-able on 2025-06-02 (RA 12023).
